About Position We are looking for a hands-on Ui Path Lead Developer to design, develop, and lead the delivery of enterprise-scale RPA solutions for a US Personal Auto Insurance Policy Rewrite and Servicing Program. The ideal candidate will be responsible for building robust automation workflows, defining integration strategies, ensuring production readiness, and mentoring a small offshore development team. This role requires strong expertise in Ui Path, workflow orchestration, exception handling, governance, and automation best practices while working closely with US business and technology stakeholders.

ROLE:
Ui Path Lead Developer Location: Pune Experience: Between 5 to 8 Years Job Type: Full Time Employment What You'll Do: Design and develop Ui Path automation workflows using Sequences, Flowcharts, and State Machines. Build automation solutions for policy rewrite, policy servicing, data validation, exception processing, and system interaction workflows. Develop reusable automation components and frameworks using REFramework and industry best practices. Create scalable, maintainable, and high-performing automation solutions. Implement integrations with REST APIs, web services, enterprise applications, desktop applications, and Excel-based processes. Design and develop automation solutions across web, desktop, and enterprise platforms. Configure data exchange and system integration workflows using modern integration patterns. Manage authentication mechanisms, data mapping, and API connectivity requirements. Implement queue-based processing, transaction frameworks, retry mechanisms, and exception handling strategies. Develop resilient automation solutions with strong fault tolerance and recovery mechanisms. Optimize bot performance and conduct root cause analysis for production issues. Establish logging and monitoring frameworks to improve operational visibility. Configure and manage Ui Path Orchestrator including Job scheduling Queue management Asset and credential management Robot monitoring and execution control Define and implement security governance standards. Manage credential vault usage, role-based access controls, and environment segregation. Ensure compliance with organizational governance and operational standards. Drive Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) activities across Development, Test, UAT, and Production environments. Manage packaging, versioning, deployment, and release readiness activities. Support UAT execution, defect triage, production deployment, and hypercare activities. Create operational runbooks, SOPs, support documentation, and monitoring procedures. Ensure automation solutions are production-ready and supportable. Lead daily delivery activities and coordinate sprint tasks. Mentor and guide Ui Path developers and junior team members. Conduct code reviews and enforce development standards and best practices. Collaborate with US stakeholders, Business Analysts, Architects, and project teams. Drive continuous improvement in automation quality, delivery efficiency, and operational excellence. Expertise You'll Bring: 5-8 years of overall IT experience with strong hands-on Ui Path development expertise. Extensive experience with Ui Path Studio, Ui Path Orchestrator, and Attended/Unattended Robots. Deep understanding of REFramework, transaction processing, queue-based automation, and scalable bot development. Strong expertise in selectors, dynamic UI automation, debugging, troubleshooting, and optimization. Experience integrating automation solutions using REST APIs, JSON, web services, and enterprise applications. Strong knowledge of exception handling frameworks, logging strategies, and automation monitoring. Experience implementing secure automation solutions using role-based access controls and credential management. Hands-on experience with environment management and deployment strategies across Dev, Test, UAT, and Production. Strong understanding of automation architecture, workflow design, and enterprise automation best practices. Programming exposure in VB.NET, C#, or Python is preferred. Experience with performance tuning, root cause analysis, and production issue resolution. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. Experience working in Agile development environments and distributed delivery teams. Ability to collaborate effectively with business and technical stakeholders. xperience in US Personal Auto and Home Insurance policy lifecycle processes. Understanding of policy issuance, endorsements, renewals, cancellations, and servicing workflows. Exposure to policy rewrite, conversion, and exception-heavy insurance business processes. You will ensure API consistency across C++, Java, and Python environments while driving scalability, performance, and platform reliability for teams across packet capture, protocol analysis, decryption, and downstream processing systems.

ROLE:
Networking C++ R&D Developer Location: All Persistent Location Experience: 6 to 14 Years Job Type: Full Time Employment What You'll Do: Design, implement, and maintain the unified Pub/Sub abstraction layer with pluggable backends: Zero MQ, Apache Kafka, Apache Pulsar, and Redis/Redis Cluster. Maintain Java (JNA) and Python bindings to the core C++ library, ensuring API parity and correct memory/lifecycle semantics across language boundaries. Maintain and evolve service discovery, including DNS-based dynamic endpoint resolution with change detection and REST API-based publisher configuration discovery. Develop and maintain partition logic, including hostname-aware Kafka/Pulsar partition assignment for Kubernetes Stateful Set-scaled consumer pods. Implement and optimise performance-critical utilities, including lock-free circular buffers, time-reorder queues, CPU affinity enforcement for messaging threads, and ZSTD compression with custom dictionary support. Maintain the Redis client library, including cluster-aware connection management, RESP protocol handling, and health statistics reporting. Own the HTTP REST server and client components, including the Open API-based code generation pipeline. Define and enforce the Protobuf message schema used for inter-component event serialization, while managing schema evolution and backward compatibility. Maintain a flow-based traffic filtering library for targeted data delivery to downstream consumers. Write and maintain comprehensive unit and integration tests across C++, Java, and Python language bindings. Work closely with consuming teams including Capture, Protocol Analysis, and Decryption teams to evolve the library APIs in response to new requirements without impacting existing consumers. Participate in code reviews, architecture discussions, and technical design sessions. Create, maintain, and update technical documentation, operational procedures, and development guidelines. Ensure platform performance, scalability, reliability, and maintainability across all supported messaging backends. Troubleshoot complex issues related to messaging, serialization, service discovery, networking, and distributed systems environments. Deep expertise in C++ development, including multithreading, concurrency, memory management, and low-latency system design. Hands-on experience with messaging technologies such as Apache Kafka, Apache Pulsar, Zero MQ, Redis, and Redis Cluster. Proficiency in developing and maintaining cross-language integrations and bindings for C++, Java, and Python environments. Strong understanding of Pub/Sub architectures, service discovery, distributed communication patterns, and scalable microservices ecosystems. Experience with Protobuf schema design, serialization frameworks, schema evolution, and backward compatibility strategies. Knowledge of performance optimization techniques, including lock-free data structures, CPU affinity tuning, thread management, compression algorithms, and latency reduction. Experience building and maintaining RESTful services, Open API specifications, API code generation pipelines, and distributed service integration. Familiarity with Kubernetes-based deployments, partition management, Stateful Sets, containerized environments, and cloud-native architectures. Strong testing, troubleshooting, and debugging skills with experience developing comprehensive unit, integration, and performance test suites. Proven ability to collaborate with multiple engineering teams, balancing platform stability with evolving business and technical requirements. Excellent communication skills with experience in architecture reviews, technical documentation, code reviews, and driving engineering best practices.
